title: Topic 6.3: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE USE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 6.3: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use, part of Christian Living in Grade 7 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why do young people abuse drugs and alcohol today?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the meaning of alcohol, drug and substance abuse and share findings with the class,

2. list drugs commonly abused by youths in Kenya today,

3. discuss the causes of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse today,

4. research on persons who abused drugs and the effects it had on them,

5. conduct an internet or library research on the effects of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse and make a presentation in class,

6. read 1Corinthians 3:17, 1Corinthians 6:10, Ephesians 5:18, Proverbs 20:1, Proverbs 23:29-35,Proverbs 31:6 and Isaiah 5:11

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the meaning of alcohol, drug and substance abuse and share findings with the class,
2. list drugs commonly abused by youths in Kenya today,
3. discuss the causes of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse today,
4. research on persons who abused drugs and the effects it had on them,
5. conduct an internet or library research on the effects of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse and make a presentation in class,
6. read 1Corinthians 3:17, 1Corinthians 6:10, Ephesians 5:18, Proverbs 20:1, Proverbs 23:29-35,Proverbs 31:6 and Isaiah 5:11

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: learners conduct an internet search on the effects of using alcohol, drugs and other substances and

make a presentation in class.

• Learning to Learn: learners discuss the causes of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse today.

• Citizenship: learners desire to live a life free of alcohol, drug and substance abuse.

• Communication and Collaboration: in groups, learners discuss the causes of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse today.

make a presentation in class.

• Citizenship: learners desire to live a life free of alcohol, drug and substance abuse.

• Communication and Collaboration: in groups, learners discuss the causes of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse today.

Values:


  -  Responsibility: learners make the right decisions and avoid alcohol drug and substance abuse.


  -  Respect: learners respect themselves by avoiding alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.


  -  Patriotism: learners decide to live responsibly by not engaging in alcohol, drug and substance abuse.

  -  Assertiveness: learners say ‘no’ to alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.


  -  Decision-making: learners make the right decisions of not engaging in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.


  -  Guidance and Counselling: learners are guided on skills and values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.
